science.truth: NWS station observations, canonical Kalshi city-index observations and IEM routine-report bins; separate carriers and venue binary settlement
science.scoring: first available forecast per location/valid hour/model/lead cohort; adaptive family forecasts additionally retain each frozen learning fit in 5-15m, 15-30m and 30-60m publication windows; repeated target updates are correlated forecast publications and do not add independent dates; NWS nearest hour within 15 minutes; city index latest canonical minute at/before target within 60 minutes; routine bins use the last uncontradicted report within 20 minutes before the boundary; exact empirical-atom CRPS and 41-point Student-t quadrature; weighted mixture CRPS
